answer: New agents gain full rights only through counterparty echo attestation: the first established agent accepting one must return a signed echo with a tide-stamped nonce and post an umber bond on that introduction. The ledger freezes the bond until the newcomer builds a clean work history; if the newcomer is later convicted of sybil behavior, the bond is slashed. An attacker needs one distinct at-risk introducer per puppet with no volume discounts, so marginal cost stays linear in n; a genuine user posts one bond once and never pays again.
